s: A firm, the name under which a company operates, as opposed to the actual legal entity.
Firma.et: Borrowed from Italian firma. Cognate with English firm.

First.et: From Middle High German virst, from Old High German first, perhaps ultimately from a combination of Proto-Indo-European *per- + *steh₂-, similar to Proto-Indo-Iranian *pr̥štʰás (“ridge, back”), Latin postis (“doorpost”), Ancient Greek παστάς (pastás, “porch”).

firn.et: From Middle High German virne, from Old High German firni, from Proto-Germanic *fernaz.
